lines.en: label nodokadorm15:
I knock on Nodoka’s door and wait for-
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Nodoka 的门，然后等着——

lines.en: You know what? Maybe I should just come back tomorrow.
lines.zh: 要我说，也许我还是明天再来吧。

lines.en: Nodoka isn’t exactly easy to deal with when she’s screaming and knocking things over, and I’ve already had to deal with Yasu at her...Yasu-est recently.
lines.zh: Nodoka 一边尖叫一边砸东西的时候可不太好对付，而我最近才刚应付过处于「最 Yasu 状态」的 Yasu。

lines.en: : AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

lines.en: But...then again...
lines.zh: 不过……话说回来……

lines.en: The last time I saw Nodoka in her manic state, she was also without pants. And that is a thing I can both respect and appreciate.
lines.zh: 上一次我见到 Nodoka 处于这种躁狂状态的时候，她也没穿裤子。而这一点是我既能敬重、也会欣赏的。

lines.en: Also, I’d feel less bad about her having a spontaneous orgasm on top of me because at least I know she would understand it.
lines.zh: 而且如果她骑在我身上突然高潮了，我也不会太有负罪感——至少我知道她会理解。

lines.en: So...fuck it.
lines.zh: 所以……管他呢。

lines.en: I’m going in.
lines.zh: 我进去了。

lines.en: But if I don’t make it out, know that I died in pursuit of something admirable.
lines.zh: 但万一我没能活着出来，请记住：我是倒在追求某样可敬之物的路上。

lines.en: scene black
scene nodokacrazy1
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！

lines.en: : Hey, Nodoka. Nice to see you’re doing well today.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Nodoka。看你今天状态不错嘛。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy2
: I had it again! The same dream!
lines.zh: : 我又梦到它了！同一个梦！

lines.en: : What dream?
lines.zh: : 什么梦？

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy3
: The girl! The one with the eyes! The one with the eyes and the hair!
lines.zh: : 那个女孩！那双眼睛的女孩！那双眼睛和那头头发的女孩！

lines.en: : She was so fucking hot. But who was she? And why? What is the relevance, Sensei? Why does she so often appear to me without saying a single FUCKING thing?!
lines.zh: : 她他妈的太性感了。可她是谁？为什么？这有什么关联，老师？为什么她总是一次又一次出现在我面前，却连他妈的一句话都不说？！

lines.en: : What does she know?! What does she know and why will she not tell me?!
lines.zh: : 她到底知道什么？！她知道什么，又为什么不肯告诉我？！

lines.en: : Is she the same one from the writings on the wall?! The same one who plagues the memories that precede my own?!
lines.zh: : 她是不是就是墙上那些字的同一个人？！就是那个纠缠着我出生之前记忆的家伙？！

lines.en: : I need to fucking know!
lines.zh: : 我他妈的必须知道！

lines.en: : I mean...do recurring dreams always {i}have{/i} to mean something?
lines.zh: : 我是说……反复出现的梦就一定{i}得{/i}有什么含义吗？

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy4
: Fuck you!
lines.zh: : 去你的！

lines.en: : Please don’t throw anything at me. Especially things that you just...generate out of thin air?
lines.zh: : 拜托别朝我扔东西。尤其是那些你……凭空变出来的东西？

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy5
: The air is not thin. It’s heavy. Heavy with the stench of mystery. Mystery that I, Nodoka Nagasawa, A FUCKING GENIUS DETECTIVE, must uncover.
lines.zh: : 空气不稀薄。它很沉。沉甸甸地压着谜团的气味。而这个谜团，必须由我，长泽 Nodoka，一个他妈的天才侦探来解开。

lines.en: : Do you want any coffee? You look like you want coffee.
lines.zh: : 您要喝咖啡吗？您看起来想喝咖啡。

lines.en: : I’m fine, thanks.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: : Are you sure? It’s {i}really{/i} good. And if you stare into it beneath the ceiling lights, you can kind of see your reflection.
lines.zh: : 您确定？{i}真的{/i}很好喝。而且在顶灯底下盯着它看，多少能看见自己的倒影。

lines.en: : Reflections carry hints, you know? Like shadows. Hints that we can use to discover the truth about all of this.
lines.zh: : 倒影里藏着线索，您知道吗？就像影子一样。那是我们能用来查明这一切真相的线索。

lines.en: : What makes the world move? Is it the sun? Or is it the strings of a puppeteer pulling us toward a giant ball of hot fucking lava that will one day consume us all?
lines.zh: : 是什么让世界运转？是太阳？还是操纵者的提线，把我们拽向一个终有一天会吞噬我们所有人的、滚烫的岩浆巨球？

lines.en: : It’s-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: : Bzzzzzt. The answer is the sun. You’re a teacher. You should know this. But it would be really fucking cool if it was something else, right?
lines.zh: : 哔——。答案是太阳。您是个老师。您该知道这个。不过如果答案是别的什么，那可就他妈的酷毙了，对吧？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: So anyway, reflections. Mirrors. Reflections in mirrors.
lines.zh: : 总之，倒影。镜子。镜子里的倒影。

lines.en: : If you were to hang yourself upside down and stare into one, would the you that you see be any different from the you that you don’t? Or are you the same in both directions?
lines.zh: : 如果你把自己倒吊起来盯着镜子看，你看见的那个你，和你没看见的那个你，会有什么不同吗？还是说两个方向上你都是同一个你？

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy6
: Oh! You know what we should do? We should find a mirror. We should find a mirror and go inside of it. We should see what’s inside of it.
lines.zh: : 哦！你知道我们该做什么吗？我们该找一面镜子。我们该找一面镜子然后钻进去。我们该看看那里面有什么。

lines.en: : It’s technically possible if we pause reality when all of its atoms are aligned. I can probably time it if you have the supernatural ability to stop time.
lines.zh: : 从技术上讲，只要在现实的所有原子对齐时把它暂停，就能做到。如果你有让时间停止的超自然能力，我大概能掐准时机。

lines.en: : Is that something you have? That’s something I think you have.
lines.zh: : 你有那个能力吗？我觉得你应该有。

lines.en: : Me? No. But there’s a girl on the first floor who-
lines.zh: : 我？没有。不过一楼有个女孩——

lines.en: : Good! Go get her. Fetch the girl. Bring her here and make her stop time so that I may spend the rest of it searching for the one that I am after.
lines.zh: : 好！去把她找来。把那个女孩带过来。带她到这儿来，让她把时间停下，这样我就能用剩下的所有时间去寻找我追的那个人。

lines.en: : It doesn’t really work that way. Also, if you spend your days chasing after someone you saw in a dream, chances are you’re going to die alone and unfulfilled.
lines.zh: : 事情不是这么运作的。再说，如果你把日子都耗在追逐一个梦里见过的人身上，你很可能会孤独而一事无成地死去。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy7
: That’s why I asked you to stop time, you fucking nuisance! Are you even listening to me?!
lines.zh: : 所以我才要你停下时间啊，你这个该死的麻烦精！你到底有没有在听我说话？！

lines.en: So, it’s good that Nodoka’s pants are off. Don’t get me wrong.
lines.zh: Nodoka 没穿裤子，这是好事。别误会。

lines.en: But it would be much better if her pants were off {i}and{/i} she was being nice to me- which is very much not the case so far.
lines.zh: 但如果她既没穿裤子、{i}又{/i}对我好一点，那就更好了——而目前看来完全不是这么回事。

lines.en: : Stop thinking to yourself! Share your thoughts with me!
lines.zh: : 别在心里自言自语！把你的想法说出来给我听！

lines.en: : I was just thinking that I’m glad your pants are off, but that I wish you were nicer to me.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚在想，我很高兴你没穿裤子，但又希望你能对我好一点。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy8
: I can be nice. Nice is not a problem for me.
lines.zh: : 我可以很温柔。温柔对我来说不是问题。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy9
: Or at least it wouldn’t be if you’d fucking HELP me already!
lines.zh: : 或者说，只要你他妈的肯帮我就不是问题！

lines.en: : With {i}what?{/i} I can barely figure out what you’re even talking about.
lines.zh: : 帮{i}什么？{/i}我连你在说什么都搞不太清楚。

lines.en: : Adventure!
lines.zh: : 冒险！

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : We have to go on an adventure! We have to uncover the thing in the thing! The one I need for the thing!
lines.zh: : 我们得去冒险！我们得挖出那个东西里的东西！我为了那件事需要的那个东西！

lines.en: : What thing?
lines.zh: : 什么东西？

lines.en: : The fucking {i}thing,{/i} Sensei! Do you need me to spell it out for you?!
lines.zh: : 就是那个他妈的{i}东西{/i}，老师！你非要我一个字母一个字母拼给你听吗？！

lines.en: : Thing! T-H-I-N-G! Thing!
lines.zh: : 东西！东—西！东西！

lines.en: : Come! Now! To the outside world! A large wooden structure awaits us!
lines.zh: : 来吧！现在！去外面的世界！有一座巨大的木造结构在等着我们！

lines.en: : Are you at least going to put on pants first?
lines.zh: : 你至少会先穿上裤子吧？

lines.en: : Pants are for the weak! I think better without them! If anything, you should also remove your pants!
lines.zh: : 裤子是弱者穿的！不穿裤子我思路更清晰！要说的话，你也该把裤子脱了！

lines.en: : We should go on a pantsless adventure and fuck inside of a mirror!
lines.zh: : 我们应该来一场不穿裤子的冒险，然后在镜子里做爱！

lines.en: : If you can figure out how to get in, I’ll let you into {i}me!{/i} I’m serious! It would be a fair trade! A tight fit, sure! But I can handle the pain if it means bringing me one step closer to the other side!
lines.zh: : 只要你能想办法钻进去，我就让你进到{i}我{/i}里面！我是认真的！这是公平交易！肯定会很紧，没错！但只要能让我离对面更近一步，这点痛我扛得住！

lines.en: : Nodoka-
lines.zh: : Nodoka——

lines.en: : Adventure! Penis! Mirror! Eyes! Now!
lines.zh: : 冒险！鸡巴！镜子！眼睛！现在！

lines.en: : I’m good. You can go without me. I don’t really want to risk being seen out in public with a bottomless teenager who looks like she’s on drugs.
lines.zh: : 我就算了。你自己去吧。我可不想冒险被人看见，跟一个光着下身、看起来像嗑了药的少女一起出现在公共场合。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy10
: You will come and you will like it! I need extra fingers to help me dig! And you have the largest fingers out of anyone I know!
lines.zh: : 你必须来，而且你会喜欢的！我需要额外的手指帮我挖！而我认识的人里，就数你的手指最大！

lines.en: : Uhh...thank you?
lines.zh: : 呃……谢谢？

lines.en: : So good for digging! Digging to find what’s buried beneath our feet!
lines.zh: : 最适合挖东西了！挖出埋在我们脚底下的东西！

lines.en: : It is there! I can hear it! I can feel it! It flops around like a fish! A fish with hooks for eyes! A hook with a fish for a mouth!
lines.zh: : 它就在那儿！我能听见它！我能感觉到它！它像条鱼一样扑腾！一条眼睛是钩子的鱼！一张嘴是鱼的钩子！

lines.en: : Let’s find the fish, Sensei! Let’s catch it and cook it! I’m a detective! I know what I’m talking about!
lines.zh: : 我们去找那条鱼吧，老师！抓住它然后煮了吃！我是侦探！我知道自己在说什么！

lines.en: : Just to confirm, you aren’t {i}actually{/i} on drugs, are you? Because I’m beginning to feel a little skeptical.
lines.zh: : 确认一下，你{i}其实{/i}没嗑药吧？因为我开始有点怀疑了。

lines.en: : No drugs for me! Just thoughts I am infected with! The thoughts of someone else! A second me! One we must collect and dissect!
lines.zh: : 我没嗑药！我只是被思想感染了！别人的思想！第二个我！一个我们必须收集起来、然后解剖的家伙！

lines.en: : Turn around! Face the door! Open it! And walk in a direction you seldom walk in! This is how we find it! This is how we uncover the truth!
lines.zh: : 转身！面对门！打开它！然后走向一个你很少走的方向！我们就是这样找到它的！我们就是这样揭开真相的！

lines.en: scene black
You know, all of that time I’ve spent with Yasu recently is beginning to feel pretty normal by comparison.
lines.zh: 要知道，我最近和 Yasu 相处的那些时间，相比之下都开始显得相当正常了。

lines.en: It may be {i}consistently{/i} more odd being around her, sure...but the thing with Nodoka is that when she’s off, {i}she is off.{/i}
lines.zh: 和她在一起确实{i}一直{/i}更古怪些……但 Nodoka 的问题是，她一旦不对劲，那就是{i}彻底不对劲{/i}。

lines.en: And as she forces me out of her bedroom by pushing against my back with all of her strength, I can’t help but wonder if she is acting on behalf of some sort of higher power as well.
lines.zh: 就在她用尽全身力气顶着我的背、把我推出她卧室的时候，我不禁怀疑，她是不是也在代某种更高的力量行事。

lines.en: I doubt she is, for she seems far too logical to involve herself with such matters.
lines.zh: 我对此存疑，因为她看起来太讲逻辑了，不至于掺和这种事。

lines.en: But whatever is causing this must be far more than the shifting of chemicals inside of her brain.
lines.zh: 但无论是什么造成了这一切，都远不止是她脑子里化学物质的变化。

lines.en: Whatever is causing this worries me.
lines.zh: 无论是什么造成了这一切，都让我担忧。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy11
: Where the fuck are we?
lines.zh: : 我们他妈的到底在哪儿？

lines.en: : How should I know? It took all I had to even keep up with you as you stormed your way over here.
lines.zh: : 我怎么会知道？光是跟上你一路冲过来的速度，我就已经使出浑身解数了。

lines.en: : I kind of just assumed you know where you were going.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你知道自己要去哪儿呢。

lines.en: : I see. I see, I see, I see, I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。我明白了，我明白了，我明白了，我明白了。

lines.en: : Then it must be a clue. There must be a reason I came here. There must be a reason I don’t know where I am. And there must be a reason you are here with me.
lines.zh: : 那么这一定是个线索。我来这里一定有理由。我不知道自己在哪儿也一定有理由。而你陪在我身边，也一定有理由。

lines.en: : I’m just here to prevent anything from happening to you as you are a teenage girl wandering around in the middle of the night in her underwear.
lines.zh: : 我在这里只是为了不让你出事——毕竟你是个半夜穿着内衣到处乱逛的少女。

lines.en: : Stop fucking lying to me. I know you’re just waiting for me to fall asleep so you can take them for yourself. Is that it? You want my underwear?
lines.zh: : 别他妈的骗我了。我知道你只是在等我睡着，好把内裤据为己有。是吧？你想要我的内裤？

lines.en: : Or do you truly want to help me with my mission?
lines.zh: : 还是说你真的想帮我完成我的使命？

lines.en: : And...what’s your mission again? Something about digging?
lines.zh: : 那……你的使命是什么来着？跟挖东西有关？

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy12
: More than just digging! Digging is just one of several means of accomplishing it!
lines.zh: : 不只是挖！挖只是达成目标的若干手段之一！

lines.en: : There is something! I feel it! I must find it! I must snatch up the answers with my own two hands! Wash the dirt off! Return it to the one who needs it most!
lines.zh: : 有样东西！我感觉到了！我必须找到它！我必须亲手把答案抓出来！把泥冲干净！把它交还给最需要它的人！

lines.en: : Wait, you’re doing this {i}for{/i} someone?
lines.zh: : 等等，你做这些是{i}为了{/i}某个人？

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy13
: There! That is where we’re meant to go! I remember now! I remember why I came here!
lines.zh: : 那儿！那就是我们该去的地方！我想起来了！我想起我为什么来这儿了！

lines.en: : Follow me to see it all! Such beautiful things! Too beautiful for people like us! Disgusting people!
lines.zh: : 跟我来，去看看这一切！那么美的东西！美得不是我们这种人配看的！恶心的人！

lines.en: : People who only live to hurt others! To make memories and pack them away like tools in a box!
lines.zh: : 只为伤害别人而活的人！把回忆制造出来、又像工具一样塞进箱子里收好的人！

lines.en: : We must dig! We must dig as if our lives depend on it!
lines.zh: : 我们必须挖！必须像赌上性命一样去挖！

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy14
: Dig! Dig dig dig!
lines.zh: : 挖！挖挖挖！

lines.en: Nodoka storms off, but her voice remains all around me as it echoes throughout an old and unfamiliar school yard.
lines.zh: Nodoka 冲了出去，可她的声音仍然环绕着我，在一座古老而陌生的校园里回荡。

lines.en: Her shirt gets caught on a bush that she decides to walk {i}through{/i} instead of around.
lines.zh: 她的衬衫被一丛灌木勾住了——她选择直接{i}穿过{/i}去，而不是绕开。

lines.en: I don’t worry about whether or not there were any thorns that may have cut her exposed legs open.
lines.zh: 我并不担心那些刺会不会把她裸露的腿划开。

lines.en: I just think about how fortunate I would be if they were to tear her shirt instead and force her into an even greater state of defenselessness.
lines.zh: 我只是在想，如果它们把她的衬衫撕破、逼她陷入更加毫无防备的状态，那我该有多走运。

lines.en: scene black
scene nodokacrazy15
: X! X marks the spot! But this is the spot and there is no X! Just the shadow of a slanted lower case T!
lines.zh: : X！X 标记着地点！可这就是那个地点，却没有 X！只有一道歪斜的小写 t 的影子！

lines.en: : I will dig anyway! Dig all night! Dig until I can fuck myself with the exposed bones of my fingers rather than the fleshy bits that surround them!
lines.zh: : 我照样要挖！挖一整夜！挖到我能用露出来的指骨而不是周围的皮肉来自慰！

lines.en: : Why are you not helping?! We have a job to do!
lines.zh: : 你为什么不来帮忙？！我们有活要干！

lines.en: : Oh...you know. Just...observing the scenery.
lines.zh: : 哦……你知道的。就是……看看风景。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy16
: The scenery will get you nowhere!
lines.zh: : 看风景什么也得不到！

lines.en: : Why does no one take this seriously but me?! Why am I the one who must endure the brunt of this world’s weight when all I want is to READ!
lines.zh: : 为什么除了我没有一个人把这事当真？！为什么非得是我来承受这世界重担的正面冲击，而我想要的只是看——书！

lines.en: : There are so many books! So many books and yet I have read them all! We need more books! We need more groceries! Plates of gray food and lavender hair!
lines.zh: : 有那么多书！那么多书，可我全都读完了！我们需要更多的书！我们需要更多的食物！一盘盘灰色的食物和淡紫色的头发！

lines.en: : Triangle! Circle! Triangle!
lines.zh: : 三角形！圆形！三角形！

lines.en: Okay, so Nodoka is officially broken. But at least she is broken in a position that I have imagined her in several times in the past.
lines.zh: 好吧，Nodoka 正式坏掉了。不过至少，她坏掉的这个姿势，我过去曾幻想过好几次。

lines.en: I kind of always figured I’d be behind her in a different way once her back arched, though.
lines.zh: 只不过我一直以为，等她背弓起来的时候，我会以另一种方式待在她身后。

lines.en: I can’t say many of my sexual fantasies involve a girl filling the space between her fingers and her nails with dirt.
lines.zh: 我得说，我的性幻想里没几个是关于一个女孩把指甲缝里都塞满泥土的。

lines.en: I also can’t say that I have any idea how to deal with this. So, at the risk of Nodoka {i}actually{/i} digging until there is no skin left on her fingers, I should probably call on someone for help.
lines.zh: 我也得说，我完全不知道该怎么处理。所以，为了避免 Nodoka {i}真的{/i}挖到手指上一点皮都不剩，我大概该找人帮忙。

lines.en: Someone who may or may not have experience dealing with this girl in her manic state. And someone not named Otoha since she normally just bails.
lines.zh: 一个或许有、也或许没有经验应付这个女孩躁狂状态的人。而且不能叫 Otoha，因为她通常会直接跑路。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy17
Thankfully, I know someone just like that. And it’s someone I should have invited along from the get go.
lines.zh: 幸好，我确实认识这样一个家伙。而且这本该是我一开始就该叫上的人。

lines.en: And while she may not have lavender hair, the perfume she wears will compensate for it.
lines.zh: 虽然她没有淡紫色的头发，但她身上的香水足以弥补这一点。

lines.en: : {i}Hello?{/i}
: Hey. What are you doing right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你现在在做什么？

lines.en: : {i}Sensei? You’re calling later than normal today.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}老师？您今天打得比平时晚。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m not really doing anything. Is something wrong? Or did you just miss the sound of my-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我其实没在做什么。出什么事了吗？还是说您只是想听我的——{/i}

lines.en: : I need your help, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实，我需要你帮忙。

lines.en: : {i}Like...THAT kind of help?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就是……那种帮忙？……{/i}

lines.en: : What? No. Well, yes. But that can wait until later.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。嗯，是。不过那个可以晚点再说。

lines.en: : What I need help with right now is Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我现在需要你帮忙应付的是 Nodoka。

lines.en: : {i}Nodoka? Is she in...bad condition again or something?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Nodoka？她又……状态不好了还是怎么了？{/i}

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy18
: Well...I guess that really depends on what you mean by “bad condition.”
lines.zh: : 嗯……这大概取决于你说的「状态不好」是什么意思。

lines.en: : Because she {i}looks{/i} pretty fine to me.
lines.zh: : 因为在我看来她{i}状态{/i}好得很。

lines.en: : {i}Sensei...what I’m asking is if she’s all...“hyperactive” again. I know that sort of thing can happen with her sometimes.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}老师……我想问的是她是不是又……「亢奋」了。我知道她有时候会那样。{/i}

lines.en: : Well, she is currently digging a hole in the middle of a random schoolyard. So I’ll let you figure out if that’s bad enough condition or not.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她现在正在某个随机的校园里挖坑。所以算不算状态不好，你自己判断吧。

lines.en: : {i}Random schoolyard? Where are you two, exactly?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}随机的校园？你们俩到底在哪儿？{/i}

lines.en: : I have no clue. I just followed her here. But if you’d like to switch shifts or come here and help me, I’d be totally fine with that.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不知道。我只是跟着她到了这儿。不过如果你想跟我换班、或者过来帮我，我完全没意见。

lines.en: : {i}Yeah...I’ll head over right away. Can you share your location with me? There should be a button you can press to-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好……我马上过去。您能把位置共享给我吗？应该有个按钮可以按——{/i}

lines.en: : I know how to share my location, Futaba. I’m not {i}that{/i} old.
lines.zh: : 我知道怎么共享位置，Futaba。我没{i}那么{/i}老。

lines.en: : Also, can you bring an extra pair of pants when you come here?
lines.zh: : 还有，你过来的时候能带一条多余的裤子吗？

lines.en: : {i}Um...did something...happen to Nodoka’s pants?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯……Nodoka 的裤子……出什么事了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : It’s more like there were never any pants to begin with-
lines.zh: : 不如说，从一开始就没有裤子——

lines.en: : FUCK!!!! WHY IS THE GROUND SO HARD?! WHY DOESN’T IT EVER RAIN?!
lines.zh: : 操！！！！为什么地这么硬？！为什么老天从来不下雨？！

lines.en: : {i}Okay...you know what? I’m going to hang up and get over there as fast I can. Just don’t forget to send me your location, okay?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好吧……这样吧？我要挂电话了，然后尽快赶过去。别忘了把位置发给我，好吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy17
: Deal. Thanks, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 成交。谢了，Futaba。

lines.en: : {i}Of course. Please keep her safe until I get there. I’ll see you soon.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}当然。在我赶到之前，请务必保证她的安全。我们很快见。{/i}

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy19
I hang up the phone, send Futaba my location, and stare down at Nodoka- trying my best to avoid having my gaze linger on her ass for longer than it already has.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，把位置发给 Futaba，然后低头看向 Nodoka——尽全力不让自己的目光在她的屁股上停留得比已经停留的更久。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I am physically incapable of willing myself to do this. So I watch as she waves it back and forth, throwing dirt behind her as she continues to dig.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，我在生理上无法让自己做到这一点。于是我看着她左右摇晃着它，一边继续挖，一边把泥土往身后甩。

lines.en: Why am I not helping her, you ask?
lines.zh: 你问，我为什么不去帮她？

lines.en: Because I don’t want to.
lines.zh: 因为我不想。

lines.en: Because I’d rather observe.
lines.zh: 因为我更想观察。

lines.en: It’s what Nodoka does best, so I think having her on the opposite side of things for once could be good for her.
lines.zh: 这是 Nodoka 最擅长的事，所以我觉得，让她这回站在对立面，对她也许有好处。

lines.en: : It’s close! So close! I can feel it! I can smell it! And all without your FUCKING help, you useless piece of meat!
lines.zh: : 近了！就快了！我能感觉到！我能闻到！而且全都不靠你他妈的帮忙，你这没用的肉块！

lines.en: : Good job, Nodoka. Hard work pays off, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 干得好，Nodoka。努力是有回报的，不是吗？

lines.en: : What do you know about hard work?! What do you know when all you do is stand in the corner of the room and dream of the day when you can make a mountain of our bodies?!
lines.zh: : 你懂什么叫努力？！你除了站在房间角落里，梦想着有朝一日能把我们的身体堆成一座山，你懂什么？！

lines.en: : My fantasies aside, Futaba is on her way over so the two of us can drag you back to the dorm.
lines.zh: : 先不说我的幻想，Futaba 正在过来的路上，好让我们两个把你拖回宿舍。

lines.en: : I’d likely be able to do it myself if I really wanted to. But, on the off chance anyone sees us, I should probably...not risk that.
lines.zh: : 如果我真想的话，大概自己一个人也能办到。但万一被谁看见，我大概还是……不该冒这个险。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t you worry about that. No one’s going to see you here.
lines.zh: : 哦，那点您不用担心。在这儿没人会看见您。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy20
: Hi!
if sarasex == True:
: You're becoming a bit of a regular here, aren't you?
lines.zh: : 您在这儿都快成常客了，对吧？

lines.en: : What? I’ve never even-
lines.zh: : 什么？我从来都没——

lines.en: : You’ve sure picked a strange place to take a half naked girl in the middle of the night, huh?
lines.zh: : 您还真会挑地方，半夜三更带个半裸的女孩来这种地方，嗯？

lines.en: : I get that “the mood” can strike at the most random of times, but somewhere private would probably make a little more sense, no?
lines.zh: : 我理解「气氛」这东西说来就来，不过找个私密点的地方大概更合理吧？

lines.en: : ...It’s not what it looks like.
lines.zh: : ……不是你看起来的那样。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy21
: My, my, my...what would happen to you if I were to report this to the police?
lines.zh: : 哎呀哎呀哎呀……要是我把这事儿报警，您会怎么样呢？

lines.en: : You know, if I took a picture of this right now, it’d be {i}pretty{/i} hard to weasel your way out of it down at the station, buddy.
lines.zh: : 您知道，如果我现在拍张照，到了警局您可就{i}很{/i}难狡辩了，老兄。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy22
: Not to mention the state your companion is in. Chances are she wouldn’t even be able to-
lines.zh: : 更别提您同伴现在这副状态了。她八成连——

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy23
: Oh.
: Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哎呀糟糕。

lines.en: : Uh-oh? What do you mean, “uh-oh?”
lines.zh: : 哎呀糟糕？你说的「哎呀糟糕」是什么意思？

lines.en: : Ooooooh, nothing...
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦哦，没什么……

lines.en: : Just the teensy little fact that your friend might have just run off since she isn’t there anymore.
lines.zh: : 只不过是个微不足道的小事实——您那位朋友可能刚刚跑掉了，因为她已经不在那儿了。

lines.en: : There’s a pretty neat hole, though. I wonder if she found anything cool?
lines.zh: : 不过那个坑挖得还挺像样的。不知道她有没有挖到什么好玩的东西？

lines.en: I turn around to find that Nodoka has, in fact, run off- which is doubly concerning because now Futaba is going to think {i}I{/i} let her get away when it was really all this girl’s fault for distracting me.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}转过身，发现 Nodoka 确实跑掉了——这让人加倍担忧，因为现在 Futaba 会以为是我放跑了她，而实际上全怪这女孩分散了我的注意力。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy24
: So, now what? You wanna hang out here for a little while longer? Maybe chat about the news and such?
lines.zh: : 那么，接下来怎么办？您想在这儿再待一会儿吗？也许聊聊新闻什么的？

lines.en: : No...I’m going to go look for the girl I just lost.
lines.zh: : 不……我要去找我刚刚弄丢的那个女孩。

lines.en: : Why? You’re not going to find her.
lines.zh: : 为什么？您找不到的。

lines.en: : She can’t have gone that far. It’s only been a minute.
lines.zh: : 她不可能跑远。才过了一分钟。

lines.en: : Sure. Maybe to {i}you{/i} it’s only been a minute. But who’s to say that time moves the same way here as everywhere else?
lines.zh: : 是啊。对{i}您{/i}来说可能只过了一分钟。可谁又能说，这里的时间和别处以同样的方式流动呢？

lines.en: : For all you know, these could be sacred grounds detached from the construct of time that we let ourselves be gagged and bound by.
lines.zh: : 说不定，这是一片脱离了时间架构的圣地——而我们甘愿让那个架构堵住我们的嘴、捆住我们的手脚。

lines.en: : Or...it has only been a minute.
lines.zh: : 或者……就是只过了一分钟。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy25
: Okaaaaaay. But don’t tell me I didn’t warn you thirty seconds from now when you realize that everything you {i}thought{/i} you knew is wrong.
lines.zh: : 好————吧。不过等三十秒后您发现，自己{i}以为{/i}知道的一切全都是错的，可别说我没提醒过您。

lines.en: : That-
scene nodokacrazy26
My phone begins to ring and I look down to see that it’s Futaba calling.
lines.zh: 我的手机响了起来，我低头一看，是 Futaba 打来的。

lines.en: And while the most ideal scenario would be that she bumped into Nodoka on the way home and is now escorting her back...I highly doubt that’s going to be the case.
lines.zh: 最理想的情况是她在回来的路上碰到了 Nodoka，正把她送回去……但我非常怀疑事情会是这样。

lines.en: : Go on. Answer it and see how right I am and how wrong you are.
lines.zh: : 接吧。接起来看看我对得有多离谱、您错得有多离谱。

lines.en: : Hello?
: {i}Sensei?...Are you sure the location you sent me is correct?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}老师？……您确定发给我的位置没错吗？{/i}

lines.en: : You mean...the one I sent you like two minutes ago?
lines.zh: : 你是说……我大概两分钟前发给你的那个？

lines.en: : {i}Uhh...it's...been a lot longer than that...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}呃……已经……比那久得多了……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But are you sure it's right? Have you maybe...moved at all?{i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过您确定没错吗？您有没有……移动过{/i}？

lines.en: : No. I haven't moved and I sent you my exact coordinates. Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 没有。我没动过，而且发给你的是我的精确坐标。为什么这么问？

lines.en: : {i}Well...it’s just that...{/i}
: {i}I can’t exactly...go where you are right now...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我没办法……去您现在所在的地方……{/i}

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : {i}Because...{/i}
: {i}Well...{/i}
: {i}It’s outside the barrier...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那在结界外面……{/i}

lines.en: I hang up the phone and slide it back into my pocket, trying to come to terms with whatever that must mean.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，把手机滑回口袋，努力接受这意味着的一切。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy27
: See what I mean? Bet you think I’m pretty neat now, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 明白我的意思了吧？我猜您现在觉得我挺厉害的，对吧？

lines.en: : Who...{i}are{/i} you?
: Who am {i}I?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}是谁？

lines.en: : Yeah. And where are we? And why are you acting so familiar with me?
lines.zh: : 对。还有我们在哪儿？你为什么对我表现得这么熟？

lines.en: : Lots of questions there, huh? Does your missing friend not matter to you anymore? You’re more concerned with {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 问题还真多啊，嗯？您那个走丢的朋友已经不重要了吗？您更在意的是{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy28
: Well, never fear! For I am also an expert cosplayer and just happened to have a spare pair of that girl’s summer clothes tucked into my socks!
lines.zh: : 别担心！因为我同时还是个专业的角色扮演者，而且碰巧把那个女孩的一件夏季备用衣服塞在袜子里了！

lines.en: : What-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: : You see, I can’t tell you who I am. That would be against the rules.
lines.zh: : 您看，我不能告诉您我是谁。那违反规则。

lines.en: : In fact, {i}we’re{/i} not even supposed to be talking right now.
lines.zh: : 事实上，{i}我们{/i}现在根本不该说话。

lines.en: : But you’ve come to a special place.
lines.zh: : 但您来到了一个特别的地方。

lines.en: : I don’t know how you made it here. Or exactly what your intentions in doing that were.
lines.zh: : 我不知道您是怎么到这儿来的。也不知道您这么做的目的究竟是什么。

lines.en: : But it’s {i}somewhere{/i} that {i}some{/i} rules become bendable while others stay the same.
lines.zh: : 但在{i}这里{/i}，{i}有些{/i}规则可以变通，有些规则却依旧不变。

lines.en: : You feel me, dawg?
lines.zh: : 懂我意思吧，老兄？

lines.en: : Your Nodoka impression could use some work.
lines.zh: : 你模仿 Nodoka 的本事还得多练练。

lines.en: : You feel me...incest guy?
lines.zh: : 懂我意思吧……乱伦男？

lines.en: : Feel free to imagine that I just said a bunch of really smart sounding stuff there, too. My impression game is normally pretty on point, but that girl’s hard to do.
lines.zh: : 您也可以自行想象我刚才还讲了一堆听起来特别聪明的话。我的模仿水平通常相当到位，不过那个女孩太难模仿了。

lines.en: : You really can’t tell me who you are?...
lines.zh: : 你真的不能告诉我你是谁吗？……

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy29
: I really can’t.
lines.zh: : 真的不能。

lines.en: : And I’m sorry for that. Truly.
lines.zh: : 对此我很抱歉。真的。

lines.en: : But the unfortunate truth is that if you knew who I was, you wouldn’t be able to go back at all.
lines.zh: : 但一个不幸的事实是，如果您知道了我是谁，您就再也回不去了。

lines.en: : Why, though?
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？

lines.en: : Because things have to happen a certain way.
lines.zh: : 因为事情必须以某种方式发生。

lines.en: : There’s a certain...{i}order{/i} to them, if you will.
lines.zh: : 其中有一种……{i}秩序{/i}，如果您愿意这么说的话。

lines.en: : Which is probably why you no longer remember even meeting me in the first place.
lines.zh: : 这大概就是为什么，您连见过我这件事都不记得了。

lines.en: : We’ve met before?
lines.zh: : 我们以前见过？

lines.en: : Oh yeah. A bunch of times.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。见过好多次了。

lines.en: : And we’ll meet a bunch more.
lines.zh: : 而且以后还会再见很多次。

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy30
: But, for now...I’ll send you off with a smile!
lines.zh: : 不过，现在……我就用微笑送您上路吧！

lines.en: : It won’t protect you from the dimensions you’ll have to slip through in order to make it back to where you belong, but at least you’ll know that {i}this{/i} is real.
lines.zh: : 它保护不了您——您要回到自己所属的地方，必须穿越好几个维度——但至少您会知道，{i}这{/i}一切是真的。

lines.en: : And that we’ll meet again the next time things get tricky.
lines.zh: : 也知道下次事情变得棘手时，我们还会再见。

lines.en: : Wait-
lines.zh: : 等等——

lines.en: : I can’t.
lines.zh: : 我不能。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : But I just-
lines.zh: : 可我只是——

lines.en: scene nodokacrazy31
: Sayonara.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: : Stop. I just have one more-
lines.zh: : 停下。我就还有最后一个——

lines.en: scene colorbars
scene happy1
scene happy2
scene happy9
scene nodokacrazy10
: Turn around! Face the door! Open it! And walk in a direction you seldom walk in!
lines.zh: : 转身！面对门！打开它！然后走向一个你很少走的方向！

lines.en: : This is how we find the truth!
lines.zh: : 我们就是这样找到真相的！

lines.en: : This is where we can be free!
lines.zh: : 这里就是我们能获得自由的地方！

lines.en: scene black
Nodoka and I go on a brief adventure through the various uninhabited floors of the dorms.
lines.zh: Nodoka 和我沿着宿舍那些无人居住的楼层，进行了一场短暂的冒险。

lines.en: I always forget how many there are.
lines.zh: 我总是记不清到底有多少层。

lines.en: Eventually, she returns home having found nothing.
lines.zh: 最终，她一无所获地回到了家。

lines.en: I do the same.
lines.zh: 我也一样。

lines.en: Along the way, I see a patch of daisies.
lines.zh: 路上，我看见了一小片雏菊。

lines.en: And it fills me with an uncomfortable sense of nostalgia.
lines.zh: 那让我心里涌起一股令人不适的怀旧之情。
